name: De Rosenroll 2026 DSGC with AIS
short_description: AIS-augmented Bed B DSGC substrate: forks the de Rosenroll 2026 cell builder, attaches a two-subsegment AIS (proximal HHst stand-in for Nav1.1/Nav1.2, distal Nav1.6+Kv3+Kv7), exposes 49-d MOBO parameter space with tier-stratified channel densities and SK_E2 slow-AHP.

entry_points.name: build_dsgc_cell_with_ais
entry_points.description: Build a Bed B DSGC cell and attach a two-subsegment AIS (proximal + distal). Returns DSGCCellWithAIS dataclass.

entry_points.name: DSGCCellWithAIS
entry_points.description: Dataclass exposing every field of the t0024 DSGCCell plus ais_proximal and ais_distal NEURON Section handles.

entry_points.name: apply_parameter_vector
entry_points.description: Write a 49-d ParameterVector to a Bed B cell with AIS: tier-stratified channel densities, uniform-channel densities, slow-AHP gbar + tau_ca_multiplier, AIS geometry, and passive properties.

entry_points.name: extend_with_ais
entry_points.description: Build the two-subsegment AIS (proximal + distal) sections, attach to soma(1), insert HHst basal Na+K. Permitted SUFFIXes (nav16t78/kv3t78/kv7t78) are inserted later by apply_parameter_vector.

entry_points.name: ParameterVector
entry_points.description: Frozen 49-d candidate dataclass: 25 tier-stratified densities + 7 uniform-channel densities + 2 slow-AHP params + 13 synaptic placement + 2 AIS geometry.
